title: Five-Finger Chord Lab · v0.9.4
changes: Added a new independent five-string experiment toggled by clicking the left controller thumbstick in immersive XR.
Five fingertip pairs (left/right thumb, index, middle, ring, little) each have their own animated string and C-major notes C4, D4, E4, F4, G4.
Each string starts with a different colour spectrum, changes colour under tension and snaps at its own length with a small randomized variation.
Multiple notes can sound simultaneously as a soft chord; the snap uses an original A4 pop and falling ribbon fragments.
After a string snaps, its fingers must separate and touch again to rearm; other strings remain active.
Only one lab mode runs at a time: right thumbstick switches back to the original thumb-to-thumb String Lab.
Local WebXR hand joints and WebAudio only; no new API calls, server settings, migrations or watcher changes.
